title: Script
lead: Turn the narration into something you can shoot: scene headings, action (△), dialogue and delivery. Click any block to see where it comes from in the novel; lines the AI added are marked.
gate: Confirm the script, break down assets

episodes.title: Episodes
episodes.lead: Each episode ends on a cliffhanger; pick one to see its script
episodes.name: Ep. {{n}} “{{title}}”

empty.title: No episodes yet
empty.lead: Episode planning cuts the novel into episodes, each with a hook, a cliffhanger and its beats. Import the novel and run story-bible extraction first.

board.lead: One column per episode. Drag a beat to another episode or place; click a beat to edit its text and emotion.
board.editEpisode: Edit the title, hook and cliffhanger of episode {{n}}
board.dropEnd: Drop here to put it last
board.emptyColumn: No beats in this episode yet; drag one here
board.locked: The episode plan is locked; beats can't be changed.
board.busy: Episode planning is running; edit once it finishes.
board.unadopted: Episode planning has a newer result that isn't adopted: this is the adopted plan, and it changes once you adopt the new one in History.

beatDialog.title: Edit beat
beatDialog.lead: Saving makes and adopts a new version of the episode plan; scripts that use this episode become out of date.

episodeDialog.title: Edit episode {{n}}
episodeDialog.lead: Saving makes and adopts a new version of the episode plan; this episode's script becomes out of date.
episodeDialog.name: Title

curve.title: Emotion curve
curve.subtitle: One point per beat: -1 lowest, 1 highest; vertical lines separate the episodes
curve.hint: Hover the curve to read each beat

script.title: Episode {{n}} script
script.speaker: {{who}} ({{tone}}):

srcLabel.ai: Not in the novel; the AI added it to make the scene filmable
srcLabel.addition: From paragraph {{paras}} of the novel and an accepted addition

script.editLabel: Edit this block (the impact shows after saving)
script.impactTitle: This script was already confirmed; the change affects later steps
script.unadopted: Scriptwriting has a newer result that is not adopted: this is it. Adopt it in History before later steps use it.

other.title: {{name}} script
other.none: This episode has no script yet. It will reuse the characters, setting and style confirmed for episode 1.
